verdict.rationale: The Search API documents real-time, ranked web results and 'advanced filtering' (docs-2, docs-17, docs-52), and the Agent API claims up-to-date answers grounded in real-time search (docs-39). That covers the freshness half of the story. However, the only filters actually named are domains, languages, regions and extracted content, which are adjacent controls rather than date filters. missing for 10: documented date-range filter parameters, documented recency filter, any statement of index update frequency, independent or hands-on corroboration of freshness.
